source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of transition metal complexes and ligands (PDF 22-23).

blocks.text: Transition elements complex ions is liye banate hain ke in ke paas aise khaali d orbitals hain jo electron jore lene ke liye tawanai mein kaafi neeche (qabil-e-rasai) hain. Fe3+ ya Cu2+ jaisa markazi ion kuch bhare ya khaali (n-1)d orbitals rakhta hai jo ligands ke lone pairs le kar coordinate (dative) bonds banate hain: maslan Cu2+(aq) + 4NH3(aq) -> [Cu(NH3)4]2+.

blocks.alt: Cu2+(aq) + 4NH3(aq) se complex banta hai: beech mein Cu (charge 2+) aur square ke konon par chaar NH3, har aik N se Cu ki taraf teer ke saath, sab square brackets ke andar charge 2+ ke saath.
blocks.caption: [Cu(NH3)4]2+ complex ion ka banna (kitab ki be-number scheme ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har teer aik coordinate (dative) bond hai: NH3 ka N apna lone pair Cu2+ ke khaali d orbital ko deta hai. Teer hamesha dene wale (ligand) se lene wale (dhaat) ki taraf hota hai. Chaar bonds hain, is liye coordination number 4 hai.

blocks.title: Complex aur ligand
blocks.text: Complex (coordination compound) woh molecule ya ion hai jo markazi dhaat ke atom ya ion ke gird aik ya zyada ligands se banta hai. Ligand woh molecule ya ion hai jis ke paas kam az kam aik lone pair ho aur jo markazi dhaat ke atom ya ion se dative covalent bond banaye. Dhaat Lewis acid (electron jora lene wala) aur ligand Lewis base (electron jora dene wala) hai; lafz Latin ligare, yani baandhna, se hai.
Charge ke lihaz se ligands ki qismein

items: Anionic ligands (sab se aam): Cl-, CN-, OH-, C2O4 2-. In ke naam -o par khatam hote hain: chloride chloro, cyanide cyano ban jata hai.
Neutral ligands: H2O, NH3, CO. Zyada tar naam wahi rehte hain, lekin kuch ke khaas naam hain: H2O aqua, NH3 ammine aur CO carbonyl.
Cationic ligands kam hain; in ke naam aksar -ium par khatam hote hain, maslan NO+ (nitrosonium) aur NH2-NH3+ (hydrazinium).

blocks.text: Donor atoms ki tadaad ke lihaz se ligands

items: Monodentate: sirf aik electron jora, aik hi atom ke zariye, deta hai, maslan H2O, NH3, CO, Cl-, OH- aur CN-.

Bidentate: do electron jore deta hai, maslan 1,2-diaminoethane (ethylenediamine, H2NCH2CH2NH2, likha en) jis ka har N atom aik lone pair deta, aur ethanedioate (oxalate) ion C2O4 2- jis ke har carboxylate group ka aik O atom.
Polydentate: aik dhaat ke ion se do se zyada dative bonds banata hai. EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetate) hexadentate hai: chhe donor atoms, do N aur chaar O, se jurta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen ligands ke formulas: 1,2-diaminoethane (H2N-CH2-CH2-NH2), ethanedioate (do C atoms jure hue, har aik ke saath aik C=O aur aik O-) aur ethylenediaminetetraacetate, EDTA (do N atoms, har aik par lone pair, CH2-CH2 se jure, aur har N ke saath do CH2-COO- baazu).
blocks.caption: 1,2-diaminoethane, ethanedioate aur EDTA ki banawat (kitab ki be-number banawat ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: 1,2-diaminoethane (en) ke do N atoms aik aik lone pair dete hain, is liye yeh bidentate hai. Ethanedioate mein do O- atoms (har carboxyl group se aik) jore dete hain, yeh bhi bidentate hai. EDTA ke do N aur chaar O- mil kar chhe jore dete hain, is liye yeh hexadentate (polydentate) hai.

blocks.title: Coordination number aur coordination sphere
blocks.text: Coordination number ligands aur markazi dhaat ke atom ya ion ke darmiyan dative bonds ki kul tadaad hai. Coordination sphere markazi dhaat aur us se seedhe jure ligands hain, jo square brackets mein likhe jate hain. Is ka charge dhaat ke ion aur ligands ke charges ka majmua hai; dhaat ka charge sphere ke charge mein se ligands ka kul charge nikal kar milta hai.

blocks.alt: [Fe(CN)6]4-: beech mein Fe (charge 2+) aur chhe CN ligands, har aik se Fe ki taraf teer, square brackets ke andar charge 4- ke saath. 'In this complex' ki fehrist: central metal ion = Fe2+; ligand = CN-; coordination number = 6; ligands ka kul charge = -6; dhaat par charge = +2; coordination sphere par charge = -4.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.2: Hexacyanoferrate (II) complex aur us ke hisse (kitab ki Figure 18.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure 'Total Charge of ligands = 6' chhaapti hai; chhe CN- ligands ka kul charge 6 x (-1) = -6 hai, is liye khaake mein -6 likha hai. Hisaab: sphere ka charge = dhaat + ligands = +2 + (-6) = -4. Har CN ligand C atom ke zariye jurta hai aur sirf aik jora deta hai (monodentate).

blocks.prompt: [Fe(CN)6]4- mein ligand, coordination number aur lohe ka charge kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Ligand CN- (cyano); coordination number 6; loha +2 hai, kyunke -4 - 6 x (-1) = +2.

items: Complexes is liye bante ke khaali d orbitals lone pairs lete (coordinate bonds).
Ligands: anionic, neutral ya cationic; mono-, bi- ya polydentate (EDTA hexadentate).
Coordination number = dative bonds ki tadaad; sphere charge = dhaat + ligands ke charges.
